summary: Cloud Billing now allows downloading committed use discount (CUD) data as a CSV file including subscription IDs for joining with usage data.

supporting_pages.title: "View and download the cost details of your invoice or statement \_|\_ Cloud\
evidence_snippets: CSV file name For the Cost table report, the file name follows this pattern: [Billing Account name] Cost table, [YYYY-MM-DD] — [YYYY-MM-DD].csv For example, a CSV file of the cost table data downloaded for a Cloud Billing account named My Billing Account , for an invoice month of March 2023 , is named: My Billing Account Cost table, 2023-03-01 — 2023-03-31.csv Note: If you download a report with the same invoice month multiple times, then the default report name will be the same.

COMMITTED USAGE DISCOUNT DOLLAR BASE : For legacy spend-based committed use discounts (CUDs) that aren't part of the new pricing model , this is the credit earned in exchange for your commitment to spend a minimum amount for a service in a particular region.
